evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer answered no concerns were raised, so no follow-up required.

top_strength: Joanna delivered both the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage fully and clearly mid-call, protecting against the customer's unstated concerns, and closed the call with a clean booking that included date, phone number, arrival window, and crew communication plan.
coaching_note: Step 2 is the foundation: ask the v4 two-concerns question (movers showing up on time or damage to items) at the opening, and when the customer says no concerns, probe deeper with 'tell me more' rather than moving straight to logistics — the lack of stated concerns often signals they haven't thought it through yet, and two layers of listening here would uncover real worry points that let Step 3's promises land harder.
